thread:
Kate (AE): Quick sync — Acme POC scope/questions. They want streaming chat + embeddings for search ranking. Can SE confirm SDK + auth approach, expected quotas, and a short success-criteria draft? Need timeline for a 3-week POC by EOD.
Mike (Solutions): I can lead the integration. Plan: JS SDK for frontend, Python backend for batch evals. Auth: API key for POC, we can enable mTLS + KMS-backed keys if they need it. For streaming we'll use SSE over the SDK, with chunked responses.
Mike (Solutions): Example quick snippet to stream with our JS SDK:
```js
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_KEY });
const stream = client.chat.stream({ model: 'redwood-2-large', messages });
for await (const chunk of stream) console.log(chunk.delta);
```
Anika (ML Eng): Success criteria suggestions:
- Quality: eval set of ~200 prompts (mix of search+chat), pass rate >= 90% on task-specific metrics (F1/ROUGE or custom label agreement).
- Latency: p95 generation < 250ms for common prompt sizes (~150 tokens) during single-threaded interactive traffic.
- Stability: no more than 1% 5xx errors across 48h stress run.
- Cost: estimated inference cost <= $0.015 per session (POC target)
Dario (Security): Need to answer their security questionnaire items: SOC2 status, encryption at rest (KMS), encryption in transit, VPC peering options for Private, audit log retention. Also confirm we can redact PII from logs on demand. I can fill the questionnaire if you send me the PDF.
Kate (AE): They also asked about rate limits and retries — can we propose safe defaults for POC and what happens if they hit quota?
Mike (Solutions): Recommend quotas: 30 rps per project, burst 60 rps for short periods. Retry policy: client retries on 429 with exponential backoff (initial 200ms, max 5s), idempotency key for non-streaming ops. For streaming, fallback to non-streamed endpoint if SSE fails.
Mike (Solutions): We should also configure prefix caching for prompt patterns to reduce cost during evals.
Anika (ML Eng): For the eval run I'll need: sample traffic profile, 200 labeled prompts, and ground-truths. I can provide a small harness (pytest-based) that runs generation + scoring and spits out pass rates and latency histograms.
Kate (AE): Timeline proposal (3 weeks):
- Week 0 (kickoff): creds + kube/VPC setup + security Q answered
- Week 1: SDK integration + auth + smoke tests
- Week 2: Run evals (quality + latency) + tuning (batching/quantization suggestions)
- Week 3: Stability tests + handoff + decision meeting
Dario (Security): Also flagging: if they request Private deployment, the timeline moves +2 weeks for infra prep and certs.
Kate (AE): Pricing question — they want to know if committed capacity needed for POC. What do we say?
Mike (Solutions): For POC we use hosted usage with trial credits. If they want sustained throughput >100 rps or guaranteed latency, propose a short Dedicated trial quote (1 month reserved). I can draft a POC pricing sheet: one column for hosted usage estimate, one for dedicated trial cost.
Kate (AE): Can someone draft the short deliverables list I can send to the customer (1 page)?
Mike (Solutions): I'll draft the deliverables: env access, integration guide, eval report (metrics + logs), tuning recommendations, handoff runbook. Will post a share link by EOD.
Anika (ML Eng): I'll prepare the eval harness and include example prompts and the scoring script. ETA end of week 1.
deploy-bot: deploy status: redwood/poc-harness v1.2 deployed to staging — smoke tests available.
Kate (AE): Awesome. Dario — I'll DM the security doc now. Team — please add any blocking items. Otherwise I'll send the POC kickoff note with timeline and ask for their security PDF.
